mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the periods with declining HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, it indicates a tight monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in a month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) both increase within the same month, it signals a tightening monetary policy coupled with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both increase in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE increase in the same month.
